requirements.quote: Sealed bids will be accepted until 11:00 a.m., September 29, 2017.
requirements.text: Bids must be submitted by 11:00 a.m., September 29, 2017.

requirements.quote: The Purchasing Agent shall have possession of the bids at the designated time.  Any bid en- route, either in the mail or at other locations in the city, will not be considered timely and will be returned unopened.
requirements.text: Bids must be in the possession of the Purchasing Agent by the deadline; late bids will be returned unopened.

requirements.quote: Bid package should be identified as “Sub 6 Switchgear” on the exterior envelope.
requirements.text: The bid package must be labeled as “Sub 6 Switchgear” on the envelope.

requirements.quote: Questions regarding bid specifications should be directed to Mark Montgomery, Director, Logan Light & Power Department, at mark.montgomery@loganutah.org.  All questions and clarifications must be received by 5:00 p.m., September 22, 2017.
requirements.text: Questions must be sent to Mark Montgomery by 5:00 p.m., September 22, 2017.

requirements.quote: The right is reserved by city to reject any or all bids.
requirements.text: The city reserves the right to reject any or all bids.
